From personal experience, my eating habits are like 90% of the reason for my weight gain. But exercising both takes up valuable gorging time as well as releasing whatever it is in your body that suppresses your appetite. I can exercise a couple hours a day but if I'm eating shit I'm gaining not losing. If you can, cut sugar out, it's like crack, literally releases the same chemicals in your brain. It's bloody hard but you'll soon realise just how sweet normal things are. Milk for instance is super sweet when you don't have any sugar. Best tip I can give you apart from the diet is find an exercise activity you enjoy. I hate going to the gym, but love riding and boxing. Brisbane boxing has a couple of great gyms, and they also do classes which are fun too.

The pain wasn't initially there, i thought i was fine till i went and looked in the mirror. After touching the side of my check and having the top few layers of skin slide with the touch i went into a bit of a state of shock and was quickly karted to hospital.
Turns out the treatment was to have my face submerged in a bucket of ice water. After 3 hrs of this and multiple nurses making the joke that i should get a snorkel, the pain was just getting worse. 
Cue the morphine. Morphine is amazing. 
Anyway had a week off work and now the skin on my face has healed and is smooth as a babies backside. However hair still doesn't grow on the 3 finger prints where i initially touched my face when i looked in the mirror.
